subject: FW: Lakeside Imaging Holdings, Inc. - $200MM Fungible Incremental Term Loan B - Launch
body:
Forwarding the Blue Ridge launch below. Lender call is tomorrow at 1pm.

-----Original Message-----
From: Leveraged Finance <levfin@blueridgefin.example>

Subject: Lakeside Imaging Holdings, Inc. - $200MM Fungible Incremental Term Loan B - Launch

Blue Ridge Financial is pleased to announce the launch of a $200 million Fungible Incremental Term Loan B for Lakeside Imaging Holdings, Inc.

Borrower:            Lakeside Imaging Holdings, Inc.
Facility:            $200MM Fungible Incremental Term Loan B
Maturity:            4/18/2031 (same as existing)
Use of Proceeds:     General Corporate Purposes
Call Protection:     None (same as existing)
Sector:              Healthcare - outpatient diagnostic imaging
OID:                 99.75
Existing Ratings:    CFR B1 / B+; Facility Ba3 / B+
Spread:              S+225
Floor:               0.00%
Admin Agent:         Blue Ridge Financial

Lender Call:         Wednesday, June 3rd, 2026 @ 1:00 PM EDT
Dial-in:             +1 (555) 010-0377, Passcode 5521
Commitments Due:     Friday, June 5th at 12:00PM EDT

The incremental will be fungible with the existing Term Loan B due April 2031 and will be documented as an amendment to the existing credit agreement. Materials are on the deal site.

Blue Ridge Financial - Leveraged Finance
